title.narrative: ROAP/IRN Emergency Support for Post-earthquake Reconstruction of Human Settlements in Hormozgan province (PERHOPE)

description.narrative:
The July 2nd twin earthquakes with magnitudes M>6.0 in Lengeh area, Dezhgan rural complex in Hormozgan province, IR. Iran, has resulted in a huge devastation of human settlements including the houses as well as water and electricity infrastructure. The climatic conditions and the effects of climate change on residential areas, especially in south of the country, has prioritized programs to improve living conditions in these areas. Based on this, planning and action in with the aim of reconstruction of the damaged area after 2nd July 2022 earthquake while performing studies for creating a plan for sustainable livelihood and optimal use and recycling consumed water water (Change in water-use efficiency over time, safely managed sanitation services and) for two villages as pilots in Hormozgan province and neighbouring provinces has been considered in this proposal. i) Goal: to provide emergency support for post-earthquake reconstruction of human settlements in Hormozgan province. Approach: The natural hazards, local capacities for productivity and other aspects of the affected settlements will be studied to develop the organizing plans, emergency support for reconstruction ofinfrastructure of water supply system for the villages will be provided Methodology: The project also aims at expanding international cooperation and capacity-building support in water- and sanitation-related activities and programmes, including reconstruction of water supply system and plans for water efficiency, wastewater treatment, recycling and reuse technologies in small settlements and villages. It also provides workshops for raising public awareness about the consequences of cliamate change in the region, adaptation methods and creation of job and small businesses.
Activities • Studies for development of plans for enhancing sustainability and resilience in the human settlemtns in the affected area, based on gender-responsive plans • Reconstruction of damaged water infrastructure in the region including a water storage tank partial reconstruction of water distribution system for one village and • Holding workshops for upgrading resilience and public awareness in society about mitigation of consequences of destructive earthquakes and climate change in the human settlements
Expected results The main expected accomplishments include: i) One 500m3 water storage tank and partial reconstructed of water distribution system in one village. ii) 2 plans for organization of 2 damaged villages with the aim of creating sustainable job creation and livelihood mechanism considering climate change consequences iii) Public resilience and awareness on climate change in two village about mitigation of consequences of destructive earthquakes and climate change in the human settlements
